mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT schedule_num, schedule_name, schedule_date, start_at FROM schedule WHERE group_num = #{group_num} AND schedule_date > TRUNC(SYSDATE) ORDER BY schedule_date ASC, start_at ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT tdl_num, tdl_name, status, due_at FROM tdl WHERE group_num = #{group_num} AND due_at IS NOT NULL AND due_at >= SYSDATE AND status != 'Done' ORDER BY due_at ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
SELECT status AS "status", count(*) AS "count" FROM tdl WHERE group_num = #{group_num} GROUP BY status
